system.requirements: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Medicine, suitable tools and supplies
system.description: As an Action, target a creature within Close Range and make a DN 4:1 Mind (Medicine) Test; it recovers 1 Toughness per success, once per day. With a medical kit, a roughly six-hour Rest lets you treat one Physical Injury per character via a DN 5:X Mind (Medicine) Test (X = 1/2/3 by severity) to remove it.
